verses.gurmukhi: ਸੰਨਿਆਸੀ ਦਸ ਨਾਵ ਧਰਿ ਸਚ ਨਾਵ ਵਿਣੁ ਨਾਵ ਗਣਾਇਆ।
verses.translit_en: sa(n)niaasee dhas naav dhar sach naav vin naav ganaiaa|

en.bdb: Sannyasis, giving ten nomenclatures to their sects, but in fact being devoid of the true Name have (egotistically) got their own names counted.

verses.gurmukhi: ਦਸ ਅਵਤਾਰ ਅਕਾਰੁ ਕਰਿ ਏਕੰਕਾਰੁ ਨ ਅਲਖੁ ਲਖਾਇਆ।
verses.translit_en: dhas avataar akaar kar eka(n)kaar na alakh lakhaiaa|

en.bdb: Even the ten incarnations (of Vishnu) when they came in human form did not see that invisible Oankar.

verses.gurmukhi: ਤੀਰਥ ਪੁਰਬ ਸੰਜੋਗ ਵਿਚਿ ਦਸ ਪੁਰਬੀਂ ਗੁਰ ਪੁਰਬਿ ਨ ਪਾਇਆ।
verses.translit_en: teerath purab sa(n)jog vich dhas purabee(n) gur purab na paiaa|

en.bdb: Celebrations of the ten auspicious days (no-moon, full moon days etc.) at pilgrimage centres could not know the real importance of Gurpurb, the anniversaries of the Gurus.

verses.gurmukhi: ਇਕ ਮਨਿ ਇਕ ਨ ਚੇਤਿਓ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਵਿਣੁ ਦਹ ਦਿਸਿ ਧਾਇਆ।
verses.translit_en: eik man ik na chetio saadhasa(n)gat vin dheh dhis dhaiaa|

en.bdb: The individual did not ponder upon the Lord with his concentrated mind and bereft of the holy congregation he is running in all the ten directions.

verses.gurmukhi: ਦਸ ਦਹੀਆਂ ਦਸ ਅਸ੍ਵਮੇਧ ਖਾਇ ਅਮੇਧ ਨਿਖੇਧੁ ਕਰਾਇਆ।
verses.translit_en: dhas dhaheeaa(n) dhas asavaimedh khai amedh nikhedh karaiaa|

en.bdb: Ten days of Muslim Muharram and ten horse sacrifices (asvamedh) are prohibited in Gurmat (Sikhism).

verses.gurmukhi: ਇੰਦਰੀਆਂ ਦਸ ਵਸਿ ਕਰਿ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਜਾਂਦਾ ਵਰਜਿ ਰਹਾਇਆ।
verses.translit_en: ei(n)dhareeaa(n) dhas vas kar baahar jaa(n)dhaa varaj rahaiaa|

en.bdb: Gurmukh, controlling the ten organs stops the mind racing in ten directions.
He humbly bows at the Guru's feet and the whole world falls at his feet.
